exposure: Sensory delivery room vs. standard delivery room
cohort: 789 nulliparous women having a single baby with a cephalic presentation who were in spontaneous labor and gave birth between March 1st 2014 and July 1st 2015 in North Zealand Hospital, Hillerød
finding: Women giving birth in a sensory room had a significantly lower risk of cesarean delivery compared with those giving birth in a standard delivery room.
mod_finding: The risk of a caesarean delivery was significantly decreased when giving birth in a sensory room compared with a standard delivery room (OR, multiple adjusted: 0.44; 95% CI 0.22-0.87).
